description: This file implements a distributed mutex mechanism for Mattermost plugins, allowing multiple plugin instances across a cluster to coordinate access using key-value operations via the plugin API. It defines a Mutex type with methods for locking, unlocking, and refreshing the lock, utilizing context for cancellation and internal goroutines for lock maintenance.

classes.name: Mutex
classes.description: A cluster-wide mutex for plugin instances, based on key-value locking with refresh capability.

classes.name: MutexPluginAPI
classes.description: Interface for plugin API methods required to manage mutexes, including setting key-values with options and logging errors.

methods.name: NewMutex
methods.description: Creates a new Mutex instance with a specified key, returning an error if the key is invalid.

methods.name: makeLockKey
methods.description: Generates a namespaced lock key by prefixing the provided key with 'mutex_'.

methods.name: tryLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the lock atomically; returns success status and error.

methods.name: refreshLock
methods.description: Refreshes the lock's expiry time; returns an error if unsuccessful.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the mutex, blocking until successful.

methods.name: LockWithContext
methods.description: Locks the mutex with context support, allowing cancellation.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock, stopping refresh routines and deleting the lock key.
